properties: Original closes only after the destination is ready and the original is rechecked idle and alone; core ends only the admitted terminals; one owner of the agent and its desk after every outcome; every call is bound to the admitted connection ID and generation; a failed or abandoned move leaves the source intact with a reason; an unconfirmed end or cleanup is reported
assessment: TLC explores both directions through admission, start, recheck, pin and desk move, second recheck, close and cleanup, interleaved with the source turning busy, splitting, ending or starting a child, either connection dropping or reconnecting, and lost or unconfirmed start, close and cleanup replies (6,592 states). Three sampled seeds replay through the real moveAgentAcross with lease-fenced sides; four model faults and two production mutants are rejected. The model found that an unreadable source after a lost close used to drop the copy, leaving no agent, and that a lost start reply did not name the copy; both are fixed and kept as replay witnesses. The 108-outcome matrix stays as consumer evidence.
remaining: Independent acceptance of the model and Q57 mapping. Pinned desks are carried with the agent rather than refused, as the town-moves requirement asks. A source turning busy between the last recheck and the close, independent Worlds, a service crash during a handoff and real harness startup are not proved; the owner check on a real Herdr TUI and herdr-core covers the native paths.

partialEvidence.review: Remapped from the serial-controller matrix to a finite model with production replay; independent PR review required.
